```sql
WITH kildare_geom AS (
  SELECT geometry::geometry AS geom
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Kildare' AND border_type ILIKE 'city'
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(rast, (SELECT geom FROM kildare_geom), TRUE) AS clipped_raster
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, (SELECT geom FROM kildare_geom))
)
SELECT 
  MAX(ST_Value(clipped_raster, 1)) - MIN(ST_Value(clipped_raster, 1)) AS vertical_range
FROM clipped_dem;
```
